title: Cabinets & Sideboards
lead: Sideboards, tall cabinets and low consoles with reeded, carved, cane, glass and plain fronts, in light and dark wood.
intro: Every cabinet has a number, like Cabinet No. 05. Ask about it by number and we will come back with sizes, finishes, pricing and lead time.

models.name: Rounded Reeded Cabinet
models.summary: Vertical reeding wraps the whole cabinet, with rounded ends and slim inset pulls.
models.more: It comes as a tall two-door cabinet or a long sideboard, shown in dark wood and in light wood.

models.name: Tapered-Leg Brass-Pull Cabinet
models.summary: A dark wood cabinet on slim tapered legs, with long brass bar pulls.
models.more: There's a tall version with glass or wood doors, sideboards with or without drawers, and low consoles with glass doors.

models.name: Soft-Corner Cabinet
models.summary: A light wood cabinet with softly rounded corners on a slim recessed plinth.
models.more: It comes tall with glass or wood doors, glass over wood doors, or as a long or short sideboard.

models.name: Ring-Pull Cabinet
models.summary: A warm brown wood cabinet with brass ring pulls, on slim legs.
models.more: The tall version has glass or wood doors, and the sideboards come with a row of drawers on top or with doors only.

models.name: Reeded Bookcase Cabinet
models.summary: Light wood reeding with rounded ends, as closed cabinets, glass cabinets or open bookcases.
models.more: It comes with reeded doors, glass doors, or open shelves over a reeded cupboard, plus a long low sideboard.

models.name: Sculpted-Pull Cabinet
models.summary: A dark wood cabinet with shaped brass pulls set into the doors, on square legs.
models.more: It comes tall with glass or wood doors, and as sideboards and low consoles with wood or glass doors.

models.name: Carved-Pull Cabinet
models.summary: A light wood cabinet with pulls carved into the door edges, on slim legs.
models.more: The pulls are carved into the doors. It comes tall with glass or wood doors, or as a long or short sideboard.

models.name: Plinth-Base Dark Cabinet
models.summary: A dark wood cabinet with rounded corners, a recessed plinth and textured brass-tone pulls.
models.more: It comes tall with glass or wood doors, or as a sideboard with doors or with doors and drawers.

models.name: Wave-Front Cabinet
models.summary: A dark wood cabinet whose front bows in and out in soft waves.
models.more: The front curves in and out along its length. It comes as a tall cabinet or a long sideboard.

models.name: Framed Panel Cabinet
models.summary: A square-cut wood cabinet with flat panel doors set inside a deep frame.
models.more: The doors sit inside a deep square frame. It comes as a tall glass cabinet or a long sideboard.

models.name: Waterfall Reeded Cabinet
models.summary: A light wood cabinet whose top curves down into the sides, with reeded doors.
models.more: The top curves down into the sides. It comes as a tall cabinet, open shelves over doors, or a long sideboard.

models.name: Carved-Front Cabinet
models.summary: A natural wood cabinet with a deep carved ripple texture across the doors.
models.more: The doors are carved with a rippled texture. There's a tall cabinet, a brass-tone open shelf over a cupboard, and long sideboards.

models.name: Cane-Panel Cabinet
models.summary: Light wood framing around woven cane panels, with rounded corners.
models.more: The doors are woven cane in a light wood frame. It comes tall, as open shelves over a cupboard, or as a sideboard.

models.name: Flush-Door Cabinet
models.summary: A plain light wood cabinet with flush doors and slim finger pulls along the top edge.
models.more: It comes tall with glass or wood doors, or as a sideboard, and is also shown in a darker brown.

models.name: Bracket-Foot Cabinet
models.summary: A natural wood cabinet on shaped bracket feet, with small brass knobs.
models.more: It comes tall with glass or wood doors, as open shelves over a cupboard, or as a sideboard.

models.name: Cornice-Top Cabinet
models.summary: A traditional dark wood cabinet with a carved cornice, panelled doors and a deep plinth.
models.more: It comes as a tall closed cabinet, a low glass-door cabinet, or a sideboard with drawers on top.

models.name: Long-Pull Charcoal Cabinet
models.summary: A charcoal wood cabinet with framed doors and long dark bar pulls.
models.more: It comes tall, as sideboards with drawers, and as low consoles with glass or wood doors. It's also shown in gray.

models.name: Brass-Corner Cabinet
models.summary: A rustic dark wood cabinet with brass corner brackets and brass bar pulls.
models.more: Brass brackets cap the corners. It comes tall, as glass over wood doors, or as sideboards, and is also shown in a pale gray wash.

models.name: Shagreen-Look Cabinet
models.summary: A cabinet wrapped in a textured shagreen-look finish, edged in thin brass-tone trim.
models.more: The finish has a fine pebbled texture, edged in brass tone. It comes tall or as a sideboard, in gray or pale cream.

models.name: Slim-Plinth Wood Cabinet
models.summary: A warm natural wood cabinet with softly rounded edges on a slim recessed plinth.
models.more: It comes tall with glass or wood doors, as a short glass cabinet, or as a long console with drawers.

models.name: Rolled-Base Cabinet
models.summary: A brown wood cabinet with a rounded, rolled base and small notch pulls.
models.more: The base and top roll outward. It comes tall with glass or wood doors, or as a sideboard with wood or glass doors.

models.name: Soft-Edge Cabinet
models.summary: Tall cabinets with softly rounded edges, in a knotty natural wood or a dark finish.
models.more: The tall cabinet comes with glass or wood doors in natural or dark wood, and there's a gently curved sideboard.
